tables.title: Where you fight it
rows: 咆哮树林、吟唱者草甸、多雨平原、轰鸣虫壳地、安眠丘陵、冰封高地、蜜脾原野

tables.title: Moves
rows: Lunges in for two bites about a 秒ond apart (the 秒ond one hits for 18)、re-aims at you between them、so one dodge won't clear both. It only bites at close range、can go again 3 秒onds later.

Its answer to you keeping your distance: after a short wind-up it runs at you for up to 4 秒onds、hits with heavy knockback. It can only turn 20 degrees a 秒ond mid-charge、so sidestep late instead of running.

Ends a charge with a horn ram into a narrow cone in front of it、and also uses the ram on its own at mid range. A shockwave slam follows straight after when that's off cooldown、so be ready for the rings.

Marks ten strike points in a ring around itself、then ten more in a wider ring. Each one flashes for 1.75 秒onds before a short ripple of lightning spreads from it、applies Zapped、and the ripples can be jumped or rolled through.
Winds up for about a 秒ond、a half、then fires three bolts across a 45-degree spread in front of it. The bolts don't home、so step sideways out of the spread rather than backing away along it.

Each thunderbolt drops a strike marker along its path five times a 秒ond、and every marker blows up 2 秒onds later、applies Zapped. The path stays dangerous after the bolt has passed、so don't cut back across it.
Calls 6 to 8 Copper Cubes into the arena after a 2-second wind-up、with never more than 16 alive at once. It often comes right after a thunderbolt volley.

Builds from the moment it spawns、with visible charge-up stages at 16、18 秒onds. At 20 秒onds it bursts、applying Zapped、a light shove to anyone close、then it moves at double speed with 50% faster melee for 10 秒onds; the burst reaches about as far as its bite、so back off at the 秒ond stage.
